name: Baoshan

queries.query: Baoshan Yunnan China official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS Natural Resources Bureau
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Baoshan Natural Resources and Planning Bureau government portal, its real-estate registration information pages, the Baoshan Real Estate Registration Center, and the official Yunnan Natural Resources / Tianditu references. No anonymous Baoshan parcel feature service with a safe native parcel ID and full geometry was identified.

queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Baoshan Natural Resources and Planning Bureau information-disclosure portal, the municipal real-estate registration information index, an official Baoshan service list naming online real-estate-registration-material queries, and Yunnan’s official public geospatial-service references. The inspected results evidence local registration custody and public service channels, but no anonymous parcel vector response, safe native parcel identity, or parcel schema was found.

registryBasis: Official Baoshan government pages identify the municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as responsible for real-estate registration information and publish a Baoshan Real Estate Registration Center annual decision report. This is local custodial evidence, not evidence of an open parcel geometry API.

officialSources.observation: Baoshan municipal government Natural Resources and Planning Bureau disclosure page lists real-estate registration information as an actively disclosed category, identifies the bureau and its disclosure channels, and names the Baoshan Real Estate Registration Center WeChat service.

Official Baoshan Real Estate Registration Center 2024 annual decision report identifies the center as a subordinate unit of the municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau, with a cadastral-information section and city registration/query operations.
Official municipal registration-information index exposes historical registration notices/results but no public parcel feature layer, schema, CRS, or anonymous geometry query.
Official Yunnan Natural Resources notice points users to Tianditu Yunnan for public standard maps; it does not publish a Baoshan cadastral parcel feature endpoint.

requests.outcome: HTTP 200; current HTML fetched and inspected. It linked the municipal real-estate-registration information category and identified public disclosure/service channels; no parcel API or viewer route was exposed in the page.

HTTP 200; registration-information index fetched. It listed public registration notices/results, including a historical cadastral-registration result entry, but no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry service or schema.
HTTP 200; official Registration Center annual report fetched. It describes the local registration custodian and internal cadastral-information/query work, not a public vector parcel response.
HTTP 200; official Yunnan Natural Resources portal fetched. The inspected current page did not expose a Baoshan cadastral endpoint.
Official Yunnan notice was readable and points to Tianditu Yunnan/public standard maps. No parcel feature schema, safe native parcel ID, CRS, or full polygon response was obtained.
